name: Eye Dropper
description: Samples any pixel of the wrapped subtree with a magnified preview and reports the picked colour (optionally into a colour history).

fields.previewSize: Size? - magnified preview size, 100x100 by default
fields.showPreview: bool? - show the preview at all, true by default
fields.borderColor: ThemedColor? - preview ring, border token by default
fields.selectedBorderColor: ThemedColor? - centre cell highlight, primary by default
fields.selectedBorderWidth: double? - centre highlight width, 2 by default
fields.backgroundColor: ThemedColor? - preview backing, background token by default
